sloka: स तद्दुरात्मा सुहृदा निवेदितं वचः सुधर्म्यं प्रतिगृह्य रावणः।गृहं जगामाथ ततश्च वीर्यवान् पुनः सभां च प्रययौ सुहृद्वृतः ।। ६.९३.६७ ।।
transliteration: sa taddurātmā suhṛdā niveditaṁ vacaḥ sudharmyaṁ pratigṛhya rāvaṇaḥ।gṛhaṁ jagāmātha tataśca vīryavān punaḥ sabhāṁ ca prayayau suhṛdvṛtaḥ ।। 6.93.67 ।।

translations.english: "Shrewd carwarrior, you are wise. Seated in the foremost chariot with your sword, kill Dasharatha's son and attain Sita."
